newsitem.title: FRANCE: Volga-Dnepr plans 5 AN-124 ex-Venice rally flights.
newsitem.headline: Volga-Dnepr plans 5 AN-124 ex-Venice rally flights.

text.p: Russian cargo airline Volga-Dnepr is to operate five Antonov 124 flights later this month carrying vehicles and equipment for the Paris-Samarkand-Moscow Master Rally, the event's organisers, MMG, told Reuters.

"The first leg of the rally is (by road) between Paris and Venice, from where the vehicles taking part will be transported by air from the city's Marco Polo airport to Turkmenbashi in Turkmenistan," an MMG official said.

He added: "The AN-124 will be making five Venice-Turkmenbashi rotations compared to three Chateauroux- Ulyanovsk rotations Volga-Dnepr operated on our behalf for our Paris-Moscow-Peking Rally last year. This is directly due to a significant increase in the number of participants for 1997 rally."
The AN-124s will transport 143 vans, 35 jeep-type vehicles, eight trucks, 35 motorcycles and two helicopters, as well as TV broadcasting and medical equipment and other rally-related supplies.
"One of the AN-124s has been specially-adapted for the rally with two-tier stacking for vehicles," said the spokesman.

A total of 140 teams is to take part in the 8,500-kilometre-long rally, which is to take place between August 20 and September 6 traversing France, Italy, Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan and Russia.
On reaching Moscow the vehicles will be "repatriated" either by road or sea, the official added. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
